gazette_source: CoCT Budget 2025/26 Annexure 6 (Tariffs, Fees and Charges Book)
major_structural_changes: Electricity Home User fixed charge renamed to 'Elec HU service & wires charge' and unbundled per National Treasury directive
Domestic tariff now has a new Service and Wires Charge (previously none)
Water fixed basic charge methodology changed from meter size to property value bands
New City-wide Cleaning Tariff introduced (separate line on bill, previously in property rates)
New fixed basic sewerage charge introduced based on property value
Eskom bulk purchase increase 11.32%; CoCT average residential increase 9.32%

home_user.description: Credit meters OR prepaid meters with property value >= R1,000,000
home_user.increase_note: Large increase due to unbundling: previously ~10% of tariff was subsidising unrelated services (street lighting, city cleaning). These costs have been moved to dedicated tariffs.
home_user.legal_note: Consumer groups have challenged CoCT's past practice of charging above NERSA-approved rates. Court rulings pending as of 2025.

domestic.description: Prepaid meter with property value > R500,000 and < R1,000,000. NEW: now has a Service and Wires Charge.

lifeline.description: Subsidised tariff. No Service and Wires Charge.

water.notes: CHANGED from meter_size to property_value effective 1 July 2025. Challenged by SAPOA as potentially unconstitutional - departing from cost-reflectivity principles.

fixed_basic_charge_by_property_value_exc.notes: Confirmed from actual bills (property valuation R4.7M). Full band table requires official gazette verification. Legal challenge pending re: property value basis.

city_wide_cleaning.description: NEW in 2025/26. Previously funded from property rates. Now separate line item on bill based on property value.
city_wide_cleaning.notes: Legal status challenged by SAPOA. Applicable to residential and vacant land only in 2025/26; all property types from 2026/27.

refuse.notes: Confirmed from Sep 2025 bill. Note: slight decrease vs 2024/25 (R191.20) — cleaning costs moved to new City-wide Cleaning tariff.
